attempts.text:
**The window opens on a spine.** Columns 0 to 10, `sseA` to `der`, are carried by 93 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 5% of calls. The model names 95 to 100% of them, fewest at column 3, `ndk`, 95%.

**A fork follows at column 11**, `yfgJ`, carried by 67%, the stretch most in regions of plasticity, 22%.

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 94 against 91%, and hesitates less there, 0.27 against 0.42 bits. It hesitates most at column 38, `hyfD`, a variable column, 0.85 bits.

**The window ends in the `eut` genes**, columns 62 to 65, [[ethanolamine utilization acetate kinase]]. The last column is `ypeA`, in 32% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 92% of genes**, 0.37 bits on average, perplexity 1.5 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.14 against 0.16 bits, and names fewer genes, 70% against 98%.

label: sseA
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the sseA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor sseA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,189 to 1,268 from dnaA. Read in 536 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying sseA once); 42,880 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.37 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 32,771 calls, named 99%, 0.15 bits; shell 8,782 calls, named 77%, 0.76 bits; cloud 1,327 calls, named 19%, 3.29 bits. Outside an RGP 33,516 calls, named 98%, 0.16 bits; inside an RGP 9,364 calls, named 70%, 1.14 bits. Columns: 26 spine, 25 fork, 29 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.14 against 0.16 bits) and names fewer genes (70% against 98%); 9,364 of the 42,880 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 38 (hyfD, a variable column) 0.85 bits, RGP 73%; column 33 (hyfI, a variable column) 0.78 bits, RGP 74%; column 35 (hyfG, a fork column) 0.78 bits, RGP 78%. The 11 columns (columns 30-40) where most calls are in an RGP: named 83%, 0.69 bits on average; the other 69 columns: named 93%, 0.32 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 26 spine columns: named 94%, 0.27 bits on average; the 54 fork and variable columns: named 91%, 0.42 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 38, is a variable column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 11 (fork), RGP 22%; the least: columns 0-10 (spine), RGP 0-5%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-10 (11 columns) spine: share 93-100%, all P, RGP 0-5%. Genes: sseA, yfhM "alpha2-macroglobulin", pbpC, ndk, rlmN, rodZ, ispG, hisS, yfgM "ancillary SecYEG translocon subunit…", bamB, der. named 95-100% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 3 (ndk), named 95%; most hesitant at column 0 (sseA), 0.69 bits.
[S2] 2. column 11 fork: share 67%, all S, RGP 22%. named 73%; 0.08 bits.

[S3] 3. columns 12-18 (7 columns) spine: share 93-95%, all P, RGP 15-23%. Genes: xseA, guaB, guaA "glutamine-hydrolyzing GMP synthase", yfgI "DUF5384 family protein", yfgH "glycine zipper 2TM domain-containin…", yfgG "YfgG family protein", "hypothetical protein". named 83-97% (mean 89%), fewest named at column 15 (yfgI), named 83%; most hesitant at column 16 (yfgH), 0.70 bits.
[S4] 4. column 19 fork: share 89%, all P, RGP 22%. named 87%; 0.74 bits.
[S4.c19]    19: pdeF P 89%; also "IS1 family transposase" S 14%, "helix-turn-helix transcriptional regula…" S 12%
[S5] 5. columns 20-27 (8 columns) spine: share 91-95%, all P, RGP 17-22%. Genes: ppx, ppk1, purN "phosphoribosylglycinamide formyltra…", purM, upp, uraA, hda, arsC. named 90-95% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 20 (ppx), named 90%, 0.41 bits.
